# 1. Introduction
This analysis preprocesses raw rental property data from Tokyo's 23 wards by extracting and transforming property characteristics into structured features for subsequent analysis and modeling.



# 2. Libraries
```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
```



# 3. Load data
```{r load_data}
# Load training and test datasets
train_df <- read.csv(
  "train.csv",
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM"
)

test_df <- read.csv(
  "test.csv",
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM"
)
```



# 4. Preprocessing Functions
## 4.1 Location
```{r preprocess_location}
preprocess_location <- function(df) {

  
  # Select property ID and address
  location <- df %>%
    select(id, 所在地)

  
  # Remove the Tokyo prefecture prefix
  location$所在地 <- str_remove(location$所在地, "東京都")

  
  # Extract ward name (e.g., Shibuya-ku)
  location$ward <- str_extract(location$所在地, "^.+?区")

  
  # Extract town name by removing ward and block numbers
  location$town <- str_remove(location$所在地, "^.+?区")
  location$town <- str_remove(location$town, "[０-９0-9].*$")

  
  # Keep the processed location features
  location <- location %>%
    select(id, ward, town)

  
  return(location)
}
```


## 4.2 Access
```{r preprocess_access}
preprocess_access <- function(df) {
  
  
  # Split access data
  access <- df %>%
    select(id, アクセス)
  
  access_split <- str_split(access$アクセス, "\t+")
  
  access_length <- map_int(access_split, length)
  
  
  # 7-elements access
  index_7 <- which(access_length == 7)
  
  access_3_recovery <- tibble(
    id = access$id[index_7],
    access_3_raw = map_chr(access_split[index_7], ~ .x[7])
  )
  
  
  # Extract walking time
  access_3_recovery <- access_3_recovery %>%
    mutate(
      access_clean = access_3_raw %>%
        str_remove_all("[　 ・：:]"),
      
      walk_3_new = str_extract(
        access_3_raw, "(?<=徒歩)\\d+"
      ) %>% 
        as.numeric()
    )
  

  # Identify simple train + walking access
  access_3_recovery <- access_3_recovery %>%
    mutate(
      simple_access = 
        str_detect(access_3_raw, "駅") &
        str_detect(access_3_raw, "徒歩") &
        !str_detect(access_3_raw, "バス") &
        !str_detect(access_3_raw, "／")
    )
  
  
  # Create route dictionary
  complete_index <- which(access_length %in% c(3, 6, 9, 10))
  
  route_existing <- map(
    access_split[complete_index],
    function(x){
      
      n_complete <- min(floor(length(x) / 3), 3)
      
      route_position <- seq(
        1, 
        by = 3, 
        length.out = n_complete
        )
      
      x[route_position]
    }
  )
  
  route_dict <- route_existing %>%
    unlist() %>%
    unique() %>%
    na.omit()
  
  
  # Normalize route expressions
  access_3_recovery <- access_3_recovery %>%
    mutate(
      access_route_clean = access_clean %>%
        str_remove("^東京メトロ") %>%
        str_remove("^京王電鉄") %>%
        str_remove("^小田急電鉄") %>%
        str_remove("^JR") %>%
        str_remove("^ＪＲ")
    )

  
  # Recover route_3
  access_3_recovery$route_3_new <- map_chr(
    access_3_recovery$access_route_clean,
    function(x) {
      
      matches <- route_dict[
        str_detect(x, fixed(route_dict))
      ]
      
      if (length(matches) == 0) {
        return(NA_character_)
      }
      
      matches[
        which.max(str_length(matches))      ]
    }
  )
  
  
  # Fix route name variations
  access_3_recovery <- access_3_recovery %>%
    mutate(
      route_3_new = case_when(
        
        !is.na(route_3_new) ~ route_3_new,
        
        str_detect(access_3_raw, "^京葉線") ~
           "京葉線(東京－蘇我)",
      
        str_detect(access_3_raw, "^東京臨海高速鉄道") ~ 
          "りんかい線",
      
        str_detect(access_3_raw, "^京浜東北・根岸線") ~ 
          "京浜東北線",
      
        str_detect(access_3_raw, "^京王電鉄井の頭線") ~
          "京王井の頭線",
      
        str_detect(access_3_raw, "^西武池袋・豊島線") ~
          "西武池袋線",
      
        str_detect(access_3_raw, "^京成電鉄本線") ~
          "京成本線",
        
        str_detect(access_3_raw, "^中央・総武緩行線") ~
          "総武線・中央線（各停）",
        
        str_detect(access_3_raw, "^小田急電鉄小田原線") ~
          "小田急小田原線",
        
        str_detect(access_3_raw, "^東京メトロ丸ノ内線") ~
          "丸ノ内線(池袋－荻窪)",
        
        str_detect(access_3_raw, "^日暮里舎人ライナー") ~
          "日暮里・舎人ライナー",
        
        str_detect(access_3_raw, "^東武伊勢崎・大師線") ~
          "東武スカイツリーライン",
      
        TRUE ~ route_3_new
      )
    )
  
  
  # Create station dictionary
  station_existing <- map(
    access_split[complete_index],
    function(x) {
      
      n_complete <- min(floor(length(x) / 3), 3)
      
      station_position <- seq(
        2, 
        by = 3,
        length.out = n_complete
      )
      
      x[station_position]
    }
  )
  
  station_dict <- station_existing %>%
    unlist() %>%
    unique() %>%
    na.omit()
  
  station_dict_df <- tibble(
    station_original = station_dict
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      station_key = station_original %>%
        str_remove("駅$") %>%
        str_remove("\\(.*?\\)$") %>%
        str_replace_all("ケ", "ヶ")
    ) 
  
  access_3_recovery <- access_3_recovery %>%
    mutate(
      access_station_clean = access_3_raw %>%
        str_replace_all("ケ", "ヶ")
    )
  
  station_keys <- station_dict_df %>%
    distinct(station_key) %>%
    pull(station_key) %>%
    .[order(str_length(.), decreasing = TRUE)]
  
  access_3_recovery$station_3_new <- map_chr(
    access_3_recovery$access_station_clean, 
    function(x) {
      
      matches <- station_keys[
        map_lgl(
          station_keys, 
          ~ str_detect(
            x, fixed(paste0(.x, "駅"))
            )
        )
      ]
      
      if (length(matches) == 0) {
        return(NA_character_)
      }
      
      matches[
        which.max(str_length(matches))
      ]
      
    }
  )
  
  
  # Remove complex access
  access_3_recovery <- access_3_recovery %>%
    mutate(
      route_3_new = if_else(
        !simple_access,
        NA_character_,
        route_3_new
      ),
      
      station_3_new = if_else(
        !simple_access,
        NA_character_,
        station_3_new
      ),
      
      walk_3_new = if_else(
        !simple_access,
        NA_real_,
        walk_3_new
      )
    )
  
  
  # Recover Ochiai station
  access_3_recovery <- access_3_recovery %>%
    mutate(
      route_3_new = if_else(
        access_3_raw == "東西線落合駅",
      "東西線",
      route_3_new
      ),
      
      station_3_new = if_else(
        access_3_raw ==  "東西線落合駅",
      "落合",
      station_3_new
      )
    )
  
  
  # Create final access table
  access_final <- tibble(
    id = access$id,
    
    route_1 = map_chr(
      access_split, ~ pluck(.x, 1, .default = NA_character_)
      ),
    station_1 = map_chr(
      access_split, ~ pluck(.x, 2, .default = NA_character_)
      ),
    walk_1    = map_chr(
      access_split, ~ pluck(.x, 3, .default = NA_character_)
      ),

    route_2   = map_chr(
      access_split, ~ pluck(.x, 4, .default = NA_character_)
      ),
    station_2 = map_chr(
      access_split, ~ pluck(.x, 5, .default = NA_character_)
      ),
    walk_2    = map_chr(
      access_split, ~ pluck(.x, 6, .default = NA_character_)
      ),
    
    route_3 = map_chr(
      access_split, 
      ~ if_else(length(.x) >= 9, .x[7], NA_character_)
    ),
    
    station_3 = map_chr(
      access_split,
      ~ if_else(length(.x) >= 9, .x[8], NA_character_)
    ),

    walk_3 = map_chr(
      access_split,
      ~ if_else(length(.x) >= 9, .x[9], NA_character_)
    )
  )
  

  # Insert recovered 3rd access
  access_final <- access_final %>%
    left_join(
      access_3_recovery %>%
        select(
          id,
          route_3_new,
          station_3_new,
          walk_3_new
        ),
      by = "id"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      route_3 = coalesce(
        route_3,
        route_3_new
      ),
      
      station_3 = coalesce(
        station_3,
        station_3_new
      ),
      
      walk_3 = coalesce(
        walk_3,
        as.character(walk_3_new)
      )
    ) %>%
    select(
      -route_3_new,
      -station_3_new,
      -walk_3_new
    )
  
  
  # Convert walking time to numeric
  access_final <- access_final %>%
    mutate(
      across(
        c(walk_1, walk_2, walk_3),
        ~ str_extract(.x, "\\d+") %>%
          as.numeric()
      )
    )
  
  
  # Normalize station names
  access_final <- access_final %>%
    mutate(
      across(
        c(station_1, station_2, station_3),
        ~ .x %>%
          str_remove("駅$") %>%
          str_remove("\\(.*?\\)$") %>%
          str_replace_all("ケ", "ヶ")
      )
    )
  
  
  return(access_final)
}
```


## 4.3 Building Age
```{r preprocess_building_age}
preprocess_building_age <- function(df) {
  
  
  # Extract years and months from building age
  year <- str_extract(
    df$築年数,
    "\\d+(?=年)"
  ) %>%
    as.numeric()
  
  month <- str_extract(
    df$築年数,
    "\\d+(?=ヶ月)"
  ) %>%
    as.numeric()
  
  
  # Convert building age into years
  building_age <- year + month / 12
  
  
  # Assign zero to newly constructed buildings
  building_age[df$築年数 == "新築"] <- 0
  
  
  # Treat unrealistic building ages as missing values
  building_age[building_age > 150] <- NA
  
  
  # Create processed building age data
  building_age_final <- tibble(
    id = df$id,
    building_age = building_age
  )
  
  
  return(building_age_final)
}
```


## 4.4 Direction
```{r preprocess_direction}
preprocess_direction <- function(df) {

  
  # Extract property ID and direction
  direction <- tibble(
    id = df$id,
    direction = df$方角
  )

  
  # Convert empty strings to missing values
  direction$direction[
    direction$direction == ""
  ] <- NA

  
  return(direction)
}
```


## 4.5 Area
```{r preprocess_area}
preprocess_area <- function(df) {

  
  # Remove the unit (m2) and convert area to numeric
  area <- str_remove(
    df$面積,
    "m2"
  ) %>%
    as.numeric()

  
  # Create processed area data
  area_final <- tibble(
    id = df$id,
    area = area
  )

  
  return(area_final)
}
```


## 4.6 Floor
```{r floor}
preprocess_floor <- function(df) {

  
  # Select property ID and floor information
  floor <- df %>%
    select(id, 所在階)

  
  # Extract the total number of floors in the building
  floor$total_floor <- str_extract(
    floor$所在階,
    "\\d+(?=階建)"
  ) %>%
    as.numeric()

  
  # Extract the floor number of the property
  floor$floor <- str_extract(
    floor$所在階,
    "^\\d+(?=階)"
  ) %>%
    as.numeric()

  
  # Extract basement floor numbers
  basement_floor <- str_extract(
    floor$所在階,
    "(?<=^地下)\\d+(?=階)"
  ) %>%
    as.numeric()

  
  # Convert basement floors to negative values
  floor$floor[
    !is.na(basement_floor)
  ] <- -basement_floor[
    !is.na(basement_floor)
  ]

  
  # Treat inconsistent floor numbers as missing values
  floor$floor[
    floor$floor > floor$total_floor
  ] <- NA

  
  # Keep the processed floor features
  floor_final <- floor %>%
    select(
      id,
      floor,
      total_floor
    )

  
  return(floor_final)
}
```


## 4.7 Bath and Toilet
```{r preprocess_bath_and_toilet}
preprocess_bath <- function(df) {

  
  # Private bathroom and toilet
  has_private_bath <- as.integer(
    str_detect(df$バス.トイレ, "専用バス")
  )

  has_private_toilet <- as.integer(
    str_detect(df$バス.トイレ, "専用トイレ")
  )

  
  # Separate bathroom and toilet
  has_separate_bath_toilet <- as.integer(
    str_detect(df$バス.トイレ, "バス・トイレ別")
  )

  
  # Bathroom facilities
  has_shower <- as.integer(
    str_detect(df$バス.トイレ, "シャワー")
  )

  has_bathroom_dryer <- as.integer(
    str_detect(df$バス.トイレ, "浴室乾燥機")
  )

  has_washlet <- as.integer(
    str_detect(df$バス.トイレ, "温水洗浄便座")
  )

  has_separate_sink <- as.integer(
    str_detect(df$バス.トイレ, "洗面台独立")
  )

  has_dressing_room <- as.integer(
    str_detect(df$バス.トイレ, "脱衣所")
  )

  has_reheating <- as.integer(
    str_detect(df$バス.トイレ, "追焚機能")
  )

  
  # Shared facilities or no bathroom
  has_shared_bath <- as.integer(
    str_detect(df$バス.トイレ, "共同バス")
  )

  has_shared_toilet <- as.integer(
    str_detect(df$バス.トイレ, "共同トイレ")
  )

  no_bath <- as.integer(
    str_detect(df$バス.トイレ, "バスなし")
  )

  
  # Create processed bathroom features
  bath_final <- tibble(
    id = df$id,
    has_private_bath = has_private_bath,
    has_private_toilet = has_private_toilet,
    has_separate_bath_toilet = has_separate_bath_toilet,
    has_shower = has_shower,
    has_bathroom_dryer = has_bathroom_dryer,
    has_washlet = has_washlet,
    has_separate_sink = has_separate_sink,
    has_dressing_room = has_dressing_room,
    has_reheating = has_reheating,
    has_shared_bath = has_shared_bath,
    has_shared_toilet = has_shared_toilet,
    no_bath = no_bath
  )

  
  return(bath_final)
}
```


## 4.8 Kitchen
```{r kitchen}
preprocess_kitchen <- function(df) {

  
  # Identify stove type
  stove_type <- case_when(
    str_detect(df$キッチン, "ガスコンロ") ~ "gas",
    str_detect(df$キッチン, "IHコンロ") ~ "ih",
    str_detect(df$キッチン, "電気コンロ") ~ "electric",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )

  
  # Remove installable stove information
  burner_text <- str_remove(
    df$キッチン,
    "コンロ設置可（[^）]*）"
  )

  
  # Extract the number of installed burners
  burner_count <- case_when(
    str_detect(burner_text, "コンロ1口") ~ 1,
    str_detect(burner_text, "コンロ2口") ~ 2,
    str_detect(burner_text, "コンロ3口") ~ 3,
    str_detect(burner_text, "コンロ4口以上") ~ 4,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  )

  
  # Extract installable stove information
  installable_burner_text <- str_extract(
    df$キッチン,
    "コンロ設置可（[^）]*）"
  )

  
  # Extract the number of installable burners
  installable_burner_count <- case_when(
    str_detect(installable_burner_text, "コンロ1口") ~ 1,
    str_detect(installable_burner_text, "コンロ2口") ~ 2,
    str_detect(installable_burner_text, "コンロ3口") ~ 3,
    str_detect(installable_burner_text, "コンロ4口以上") ~ 4,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  )

  
  # Identify whether a stove can be installed
  stove_installable <- as.integer(
    str_detect(df$キッチン, "コンロ設置可")
  )

  
  # Kitchen facilities
  has_system_kitchen <- as.integer(
    str_detect(df$キッチン, "システムキッチン")
  )

  has_hot_water <- as.integer(
    str_detect(df$キッチン, "給湯")
  )

  has_separate_kitchen <- as.integer(
    str_detect(df$キッチン, "独立キッチン")
  )

  has_fridge <- as.integer(
    str_detect(df$キッチン, "冷蔵庫あり")
  )

  has_counter_kitchen <- as.integer(
    str_detect(df$キッチン, "カウンターキッチン")
  )

  has_l_shaped_kitchen <- as.integer(
    str_detect(df$キッチン, "L字キッチン")
  )

  
  # Create processed kitchen features
  kitchen_final <- tibble(
    id = df$id,
    stove_type = stove_type,
    burner_count = burner_count,
    installable_burner_count = installable_burner_count,
    stove_installable = stove_installable,
    has_system_kitchen = has_system_kitchen,
    has_hot_water = has_hot_water,
    has_separate_kitchen = has_separate_kitchen,
    has_fridge = has_fridge,
    has_counter_kitchen = has_counter_kitchen,
    has_l_shaped_kitchen = has_l_shaped_kitchen
  )

  
  return(kitchen_final)
}
```


## 4.9 Broadcast
```{r broadcast}
preprocess_broadcast <- function(df) {

  
  # Internet connectivity
  has_internet <- as.integer(
    str_detect(df$放送.通信, "インターネット対応")
  )

  has_fiber_optic <- as.integer(
    str_detect(df$放送.通信, "光ファイバー")
  )

  has_high_speed_internet <- as.integer(
    str_detect(df$放送.通信, "高速インターネット")
  )

  has_free_internet <- as.integer(
    str_detect(df$放送.通信, "インターネット使用料無料")
  )

  
  # Television and broadcasting services
  has_catv <- as.integer(
    str_detect(df$放送.通信, "CATV")
  )

  has_cs_antenna <- as.integer(
    str_detect(df$放送.通信, "CSアンテナ")
  )

  has_bs_antenna <- as.integer(
    str_detect(df$放送.通信, "BSアンテナ")
  )

  has_cable_broadcast <- as.integer(
    str_detect(df$放送.通信, "有線放送")
  )

  
  # Create processed communication features
  broadcast_final <- tibble(
    id = df$id,
    has_internet = has_internet,
    has_catv = has_catv,
    has_cs_antenna = has_cs_antenna,
    has_bs_antenna = has_bs_antenna,
    has_fiber_optic = has_fiber_optic,
    has_high_speed_internet = has_high_speed_internet,
    has_free_internet = has_free_internet,
    has_cable_broadcast = has_cable_broadcast
  )

  
  return(broadcast_final)
}
```


## 4.10 Equipment
```{r preprocess_equipment}
preprocess_equipment <- function(df) {

  
  # Air conditioning and heating
  has_air_conditioner <- as.integer(
    str_detect(df$室内設備, "エアコン付")
  )

  has_cooling <- as.integer(
    str_detect(df$室内設備, "冷房")
  )

  has_floor_heating <- as.integer(
    str_detect(df$室内設備, "床暖房")
  )

  has_oil_heating <- as.integer(
    str_detect(df$室内設備, "石油暖房")
  )

  has_gas_heating <- as.integer(
    str_detect(df$室内設備, "ガス暖房")
  )

  
  # Storage facilities
  has_shoe_box <- as.integer(
    str_detect(df$室内設備, "シューズボックス")
  )

  has_walk_in_closet <- as.integer(
    str_detect(df$室内設備, "ウォークインクローゼット")
  )

  has_trunk_room <- as.integer(
    str_detect(df$室内設備, "トランクルーム")
  )

  has_underfloor_storage <- as.integer(
    str_detect(df$室内設備, "床下収納")
  )

  
  # Balcony and outdoor spaces
  has_balcony <- as.integer(
    str_detect(
      str_remove_all(df$室内設備, "ルーフバルコニー"),
      "バルコニー"
    )
  )

  has_roof_balcony <- as.integer(
    str_detect(df$室内設備, "ルーフバルコニー")
  )

  has_private_garden <- as.integer(
    str_detect(df$室内設備, "専用庭")
  )

  
  # Interior features
  has_flooring <- as.integer(
    str_detect(df$室内設備, "フローリング")
  )

  has_cushion_floor <- as.integer(
    str_detect(df$室内設備, "クッションフロア")
  )

  has_loft <- as.integer(
    str_detect(df$室内設備, "ロフト付き")
  )

  has_bay_window <- as.integer(
    str_detect(df$室内設備, "出窓")
  )

  has_basement <- as.integer(
    str_detect(df$室内設備, "地下室")
  )

  # Lighting, windows, and ventilation
  has_two_side_lighting <- as.integer(
    str_detect(df$室内設備, "2面採光")
  )

  has_three_side_lighting <- as.integer(
    str_detect(df$室内設備, "3面採光")
```

## 4.11 Parking
```{r preprocess_parking}
preprocess_parking <- function(df) {

  # Map full-width digits to half-width digits
  digit_map <- c(
    "０" = "0", "１" = "1", "２" = "2",
    "３" = "3", "４" = "4", "５" = "5",
    "６" = "6", "７" = "7", "８" = "8",
    "９" = "9"
  )

  # --------------------------------------------------
  # Car parking
  # --------------------------------------------------

  # Extract car parking information
  parking_text <- str_extract(
    df$駐車場,
    "駐車場.*?(?=バイク置き場|駐輪場|$)"
  )

  # Classify parking availability
  parking_status <- case_when(
    str_detect(parking_text, "駐車場\\s*空有") ~ "available",
    str_detect(parking_text, "駐車場\\s*空無") ~ "unavailable",
    str_detect(parking_text, "駐車場\\s*近隣") ~ "nearby",
    str_detect(parking_text, "駐車場\\s*無") ~ "none",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )

  # Extract parking fee
  parking_fee <- str_extract(
    parking_text,
    "[\\d,]+(?=円)"
  ) %>%
    str_remove_all(",") %>%
    str_replace_all(digit_map) %>%
    as.numeric()

  # Convert annual fees to monthly fees
  parking_fee <- if_else(
    str_detect(parking_text, "年額"),
    parking_fee / 12,
    parking_fee
  )

  # Extract distance to parking
  parking_distance <- str_extract(
    parking_text,
    "\\d+(?=m)"
  ) %>%
    str_replace_all(digit_map) %>%
    as.numeric()

  # --------------------------------------------------
  # Bicycle parking
  # --------------------------------------------------

  # Extract bicycle parking information
  bicycle_parking_text <- str_extract(
    df$駐車場,
    "駐輪場.*?(?=駐車場|バイク置き場|$)"
  )

  # Classify bicycle parking availability
  bicycle_parking_status <- case_when(
    str_detect(bicycle_parking_text, "駐輪場\\s*空有") ~ "available",
    str_detect(bicycle_parking_text, "駐輪場\\s*空無") ~ "unavailable",
    str_detect(bicycle_parking_text, "駐輪場\\s*近隣") ~ "nearby",
    str_detect(bicycle_parking_text, "駐輪場\\s*無") ~ "none",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )

  # Extract bicycle parking fee
  bicycle_parking_fee <- str_extract(
    bicycle_parking_text,
    "[\\d,]+(?=円)"
  ) %>%
    str_remove_all(",") %>%
    str_replace_all(digit_map) %>%
    as.numeric()

  # Convert annual fees to monthly fees
  bicycle_parking_fee <- if_else(
    str_detect(bicycle_parking_text, "年額"),
    bicycle_parking_fee / 12,
    bicycle_parking_fee
  )

  # --------------------------------------------------
  # Motorcycle parking
  # --------------------------------------------------

  # Extract motorcycle parking information
  motorcycle_parking_text <- str_extract(
    df$駐車場,
    "バイク置き場.*?(?=駐車場|駐輪場|$)"
  )

  # Classify motorcycle parking availability
  motorcycle_parking_status <- case_when(
    str_detect(motorcycle_parking_text, "バイク置き場\\s*空有") ~ "available",
    str_detect(motorcycle_parking_text, "バイク置き場\\s*空無") ~ "unavailable",
    str_detect(motorcycle_parking_text, "バイク置き場\\s*近隣") ~ "nearby",
    str_detect(motorcycle_parking_text, "バイク置き場\\s*無") ~ "none",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )

  # Extract motorcycle parking fee
  motorcycle_parking_fee <- str_extract(
    motorcycle_parking_text,
    "[\\d,]+(?=円)"
  ) %>%
    str_remove_all(",") %>%
    str_replace_all(digit_map) %>%
    as.numeric()

  # Convert annual fees to monthly fees
  motorcycle_parking_fee <- if_else(
    str_detect(motorcycle_parking_text, "年額"),
    motorcycle_parking_fee / 12,
    motorcycle_parking_fee
  )

  # --------------------------------------------------
  # Create processed parking features
  # --------------------------------------------------

  parking_final <- tibble(
    id = df$id,
    parking_status = parking_status,
    parking_fee = parking_fee,
    parking_distance = parking_distance,
    bicycle_parking_status = bicycle_parking_status,
    bicycle_parking_fee = bicycle_parking_fee,
    motorcycle_parking_status = motorcycle_parking_status,
    motorcycle_parking_fee = motorcycle_parking_fee
  )

  return(parking_final)
}
```


## 4.12 Environment
```{r preprocess_environment}
preprocess_environment <- function(df) {

  
  # Extract facility types from brackets
  environment_facility <- str_extract_all(
    df$周辺環境,
    "(?<=【).*?(?=】)"
  )

  
  # Extract distances to nearby facilities
  environment_distance <- str_extract_all(
    df$周辺環境,
    "\\d+(?=m)"
  )

  
  # Convert extracted information to long format
  environment_long <- map(
    seq_along(environment_facility),
    function(i) {

      if (length(environment_facility[[i]]) == 0) {
        return(NULL)
      }

      tibble(
        id = df$id[i],
        facility = environment_facility[[i]],
        distance = environment_distance[[i]]
      )
    }
  ) %>%
    bind_rows()

  
  # Convert distances to numeric values
  environment_long$distance <- as.numeric(
    environment_long$distance
  )

  
  # Summarize nearby facilities by property and type
  environment_summary <- environment_long %>%
    group_by(id, facility) %>%
    summarise(
      nearest_distance = min(distance),
      facility_count = n(),
      count_within_500m = sum(distance <= 500),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  
  # Convert summarized features to wide format
  environment_wide <- environment_summary %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = facility,
      values_from = c(
        nearest_distance,
        facility_count,
        count_within_500m
      )
    )

  
  return(environment_wide)
}
```


## 4.13 Contract
```{r preprocess_contract}
preprocess_contract <- function(df) {

  
  # Exclude contract periods specified by an end date
  contract_period <- if_else(
    str_detect(df$契約期間, "まで"),
    NA_character_,
    df$契約期間
  )

  
  # Extract contract duration in years
  contract_year <- str_extract(
    contract_period,
    "\\d+(?=年)"
  ) %>%
    as.numeric()

  
  # Extract contract duration in months
  contract_month <- str_extract(
    contract_period,
    "\\d+(?=ヶ月)"
  ) %>%
    as.numeric()

  
  # Convert contract duration to total months
  contract_months <- if_else(
    is.na(contract_year) & is.na(contract_month),
    NA_real_,
    coalesce(contract_year, 0) * 12 +
      coalesce(contract_month, 0)
  )

  
  # Extract the contract end year
  end_year <- str_extract(
    df$契約期間,
    "\\d{4}(?=年)"
  ) %>%
    as.numeric()

  
  # Extract the contract end month
  end_month <- str_extract(
    df$契約期間,
    "(?<=年)\\d{1,2}(?=月)"
  ) %>%
    as.numeric()

  
  # Calculate months until contract end (August 2019)
  months_until_end <- (end_year - 2019) * 12 +
    (end_month - 8)

  
  # Identify fixed-term rental contracts
  fixed_term <- case_when(
    df$契約期間 == "" ~ NA_real_,
    str_detect(df$契約期間, "定期借家") ~ 1,
    TRUE ~ 0
  )

  
  # Create processed contract features
  contract_final <- tibble(
    id = df$id,
    contract_months = contract_months,
    months_until_end = months_until_end,
    fixed_term = fixed_term
  )

  
  return(contract_final)
}
```



# 5. Combine Processed Features
```{r combine_data}
# Facility name mapping
facility_names <- c(
  "コンビニ" = "convenience_store",
  "スーパー" = "supermarket",
  "ドラッグストア" = "drugstore",
  "公園" = "park",
  "大学" = "university",
  "小学校" = "elementary_school",
  "郵便局" = "post_office",
  "飲食店" = "restaurant",
  "図書館" = "library",
  "総合病院" = "general_hospital",
  "病院" = "hospital",
  "銀行" = "bank",
  "学校" = "school",
  "幼稚園・保育園" = "kindergarten_nursery",
  "デパート" = "department_store",
  "レンタルビデオ" = "video_rental",
  "クリーニング" = "dry_cleaner",
  "コインパーキング" = "coin_parking",
  "月極駐車場" = "monthly_parking"
)


combine_features <- function(df, is_train = TRUE) {


  # Select original columns
  original_cols <- c("id", "間取り", "建物構造")

  if (is_train) {
    original_cols <- c("id", "賃料", "間取り", "建物構造")
  }


  # Apply preprocessing functions and combine features
  processed_data <- df %>%
    select(all_of(original_cols)) %>%
    left_join(preprocess_location(df), by = "id") %>%
    left_join(preprocess_access(df), by = "id") %>%
    left_join(preprocess_building_age(df), by = "id") %>%
    left_join(preprocess_direction(df), by = "id") %>%
    left_join(preprocess_area(df), by = "id") %>%
    left_join(preprocess_floor(df), by = "id") %>%
    left_join(preprocess_bath(df), by = "id") %>%
    left_join(preprocess_kitchen(df), by = "id") %>%
    left_join(preprocess_broadcast(df), by = "id") %>%
    left_join(preprocess_equipment(df), by = "id") %>%
    left_join(preprocess_parking(df), by = "id") %>%
    left_join(preprocess_environment(df), by = "id") %>%
    left_join(preprocess_contract(df), by = "id") %>%
    rename(
      layout = 間取り,
      building_structure = 建物構造
    )

  if (is_train) {
    processed_data <- processed_data %>%
      rename(rent = 賃料)
  }

  # Replace Japanese facility names in column names
  for (japanese_name in names(facility_names)) {
    names(processed_data) <- str_replace_all(
      names(processed_data),
      fixed(japanese_name),
      facility_names[[japanese_name]]
    )
  }

  return(processed_data)
}


# Process both datasets
processed_train <- combine_features(train_df, is_train = TRUE)
processed_test <- combine_features(test_df, is_train = FALSE)


# Add target placeholder to test data
processed_test$rent <- NA_real_


# Add missing training columns to test data
missing_cols <- setdiff(
  names(processed_train),
  names(processed_test)
)

for (col in missing_cols) {
  processed_test[[col]] <- NA
}


# Match training column order
processed_test <- processed_test[
  , names(processed_train), drop = FALSE
]


# Validate processed datasets
stopifnot(
  nrow(processed_train) == nrow(train_df),
  nrow(processed_test) == nrow(test_df),
  identical(names(processed_train), names(processed_test)),
  !anyDuplicated(processed_train$id),
  !anyDuplicated(processed_test$id)
)
```
